chunks: So will they confess their guilt. Deprived (of all joys) will be the inmates of Hell.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the inhabitants of Hell when they confess their sins?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the futility of late repentance, as the sinners' confession comes only when the verdict is irreversible, emphasizing the finality of divine justice. The phrase 'soorqan' (total destruction) underscores the complete severance from mercy for the inhabitants of the Hellfire, a concept often linked to the fate of those who rejected the Imams' authority. This moment serves as a stark warning against delaying spiritual accountability until the Day of Judgment.
